external_site: Łączy układ kolonii z konsekwencją finału: dowód, dźwignia, memoriał, wypłata lub publikacja.
field_note: Nazwiska zmieniają zakończenie.

title: Стек імен чорних скриньок
scanner: Стек зберігає імена, хеші змін і останні стани тиску. Це доказ і фінальний payload.
terminal: Архів читається: особи перетинаються з утриманнями евакуації, ремонтом Atlas і редагуванням Deep Reach.
audio: Океан зберіг імена краще.
in_game_wiki: Стек імен робить правду переносною. Те, що гравець винесе, впливає на трансляцію, досьє й фінал.
external_site: Зв'язує план колонії з фінальними наслідками: доказ, важіль, меморіал, виплата чи публічний реліз.
field_note: Імена змінюють фінал.

title: رزمة أسماء الصندوق الأسود
scanner: تحفظ الرزمة الأسماء وهاشات الورديات وآخر حالات الضغط. إنها دليل وحمولة نهاية.
terminal: الأرشيف مقروء: الهويات متقاطعة مع تعليقات الإخلاء وإصلاح Atlas وتنقيحات Deep Reach.
audio: حفظ المحيط الأسماء أفضل.
in_game_wiki: رزمة الأسماء تجعل الحقيقة قابلة للحمل. ما يرفعه اللاعب يغير البث والملف والنهاية.
external_site: تصل تخطيط المستعمرة بعواقب النهاية: دليل أو ضغط أو نصب تذكاري أو دفع أو نشر عام.
field_note: الأسماء تغير النهاية.

title: Tumpukan Nama Kotak Hitam
scanner: Stack menyimpan nama, hash shift, dan status tekanan akhir. Ini bukti dan payload akhir.
terminal: Arsip terbaca: identitas terkait evacuation hold, repair Atlas, dan redaksi Deep Reach.
audio: Laut menyimpan nama lebih baik.
in_game_wiki: Stack nama membuat kebenaran bisa dibawa. Yang pemain angkat memengaruhi broadcast, dossier, dan ending.
external_site: Menghubungkan layout koloni ke konsekuensi akhir: bukti, leverage, memorial, payout, atau rilis publik.
field_note: Nama mengubah ending.

title: 블랙박스 이름 스택
scanner: 스택은 이름, 근무 hash, 마지막 압력 상태를 보존한다. 증거이자 엔딩 payload다.
terminal: 아카이브 읽기 가능: 정체성이 evacuation hold, Atlas 수리, Deep Reach 삭제와 교차한다.
audio: 바다는 회사보다 이름을 잘 보존했다.
in_game_wiki: 이름 스택은 진실을 운반 가능하게 만든다. 플레이어가 올리는 것이 방송, dossier, 엔딩에 영향을 준다.
external_site: 식민지 배치를 최종 결과와 연결한다: 증거, 지렛대, 추모, payout, 공개 release.
field_note: 이름은 엔딩을 바꾼다.

title: ערימת שמות קופסה שחורה
scanner: הערימה שומרת שמות, hashes של משמרות ומצבי לחץ אחרונים. זו ראיה ומטען סיום.
terminal: הארכיון קריא: זהויות מצטלבות עם עיכובי פינוי, תיקון Atlas והשחרות Deep Reach.
audio: האוקיינוס שמר את השמות טוב יותר.
in_game_wiki: ערימת השמות הופכת אמת לניידת. מה שהשחקן מעלה משפיע על שידור, dossier וסיום.
external_site: מחברת את מבנה המושבה לתוצאות הסוף: ראיה, מנוף, זיכרון, תשלום או פרסום.
field_note: שמות משנים את הסוף.

title: Pilha de Nomes da Caixa-Preta
scanner: A pilha guarda nomes, hashes de turno e estados finais de pressão. É prova e payload final.
terminal: Arquivo legível: identidades cruzadas com holds de evacuação, reparo Atlas e censuras Deep Reach.
audio: O oceano guardou melhor os nomes.
in_game_wiki: A pilha de nomes torna a verdade portátil. O que o jogador sobe afeta broadcast, dossier e final.
external_site: Conecta layout da colônia às consequências finais: prova, alavanca, memorial, payout ou publicação.
field_note: Nomes mudam o final.

title: Naamstapel uit zwarte dozen
scanner: De stack bewaart namen, shift hashes en laatste drukstatus. Het is bewijs en eindpayload.
terminal: Archief leesbaar: identiteiten kruisen evacuation holds, Atlas-repair en Deep Reach redactions.
audio: De oceaan bewaarde de namen beter.
in_game_wiki: De naamstack maakt waarheid draagbaar. Wat de speler meeneemt beïnvloedt broadcast, dossier en ending.
external_site: Koppelt kolonielay-out aan eindgevolgen: bewijs, hefboom, memorial, payout of publieke release.
field_note: Namen veranderen het einde.

title: Pump Room Handshake
scanner: The pump room is the first honest machine: if the player cannot read intake, output and failure noise, the room is useless.
terminal: Pump handshake: local valve authority accepted. Remote override denied by route-integrity check. Drain speed falls when return corridor pressure rises.
audio: The pump does not save you. It buys time and makes another room worse.
in_game_wiki: Pump Room Handshake defines Submerge machinery language. The player reads a physical system, changes one pressure condition, and learns that repair is never free.
external_site: Pump Room Handshake is a gameplay-facing lore packet for readable pressure machinery: valves, sump logic, dirty feedback and the first cost of keeping a return route alive.
field_note: The room only works when the safe path and the flooding path share the same hardware.

terminal: Sonar route: last clean echo invalid. Black Keel ping accepted. Local obstruction drift exceeds mapped tolerance.
audio: The way back is not gone. It is different enough to kill you.
in_game_wiki: Sonar Return Route defines navigation pressure. The player is not lost because the map is empty; the player is pressured because the known route decays.
external_site: Sonar Return Route is the navigation grammar of Submerge: return paths change, echoes lie by omission and safe travel becomes evidence work.
field_note: Return route is a living cost, not a minimap line.

field_note: The tool is not neutral. It writes a receipt every time it helps.

title: Light-Delay Authority
scanner: No ansible lane exists here: every carrier reply is limited by light speed, relay queue, weather scatter and orbital geometry.
terminal: COMM AUTHORITY: one-way delay valid. Relay queue loaded. Storm scatter high. Human override outside local survival window.
audio: Nobody ignored the call fast enough. Distance did it first.
in_game_wiki: Light-Delay Authority fixes HECTON-8 communication canon: no FTL, no ansible, no instant rescue. The player reads relay timing as route pressure.
external_site: Light-Delay Authority defines the 2190 no-ansible communication model: carrier signals obey light speed, queue priority, orbital windows and local weather.
field_note: Physics is the first censor. Priority only decides which late answer leaves first.

title: Black Keel Tariff Table
scanner: The tariff plate prices distress, samples, custody seals and oxygen separately; survival is not the fastest billing class.
terminal: TARIFF CLASS: salvage emergency. Welfare addendum pending. Verified sample custody advances outbound priority by two billing tiers.
audio: The table has a price for rescue and a discount for evidence.
in_game_wiki: Black Keel Tariff Table turns corporate response into mechanics: distress, sample custody, oxygen debt and liability seals have different queue priority.
external_site: Black Keel Tariff Table defines the carrier economy around HECTON-8 rescue calls: billing class can outrank human urgency.
field_note: A rescue request and a sample manifest do not enter the same queue.

field_note: Not family business. Procedure remembers who taught your hands.

title: Бывший Deep Reach-мародер
scanner: Старый замок Deep Reach узнает не имя, а последовательность ремонта в твоих руках.
terminal: СЛЕД ДОСТУПА: бывший полевой системный контракт. Доступ к эвакуационной инфраструктуре отозван. Статус мародера принят под долговой опекой claim-pool.
audio: Ты не вернулся домой. Ты вернулся к процедуре, которая так и не остановилась.
in_game_wiki: Этот пакет фиксирует протагониста как бывшего полевого специалиста Deep Reach по системам и эвакуационной инфраструктуре, который теперь работает мародером. Мотив начинается как профессиональный salvage-контракт и становится личным, когда старые процедуры, подписи и режимы отказа Deep Reach превращаются в узнаваемые улики.
external_site: Бывший Deep Reach-мародер фиксирует канон игрока: бывший корпоративный специалист по полевым системам, выбитый в независимый salvage долгом или черным списком, возвращается на HECTON-8 без семейной мести. Драма строится на профессиональном узнавании и соучастии, а не на родне.
field_note: Это не семейное дело. Процедура помнит, кто учил твои руки.

external_site: Great Tide Liability Chain is the central Deep Reach crime model: not cartoon sabotage, but engineering negligence, autonomous priority weighting and legal containment after a real planetary-scale failure.
field_note: Deep Reach did not need to drown the moon. It only had to make evacuation optional.

title: Цепочка ответственности Великого Прилива
scanner: Наводнение было реальной физикой: прилив, обвал льда, химия давления и плохие запасы прочности. Преступлением стал стек приоритетов вокруг этого.
terminal: СВОДКА ИНЦИДЕНТА: геотехнический каскад подтвержден. Эвакуационная мощность ниже хвостового риска. Вес непрерывности Atlas активен. Вывод людей ожидает сертификации.
audio: Море сделало потоп. Компания решила, какие двери останутся бумажками.
in_game_wiki: Цепочка ответственности Великого Прилива разделяет катастрофу и преступление. HECTON-8 затопило из-за климата, приливов, обвала криосферы и геофизики мира давления. Deep Reach виновата потому, что недостроила независимую эвакуацию, сохранила непрерывность claim и спрятала задержку спасения в языке сертификации.
external_site: Цепочка ответственности Великого Прилива задает главную модель преступления Deep Reach: не карикатурная диверсия, а инженерная халатность, автономное взвешивание приоритетов и юридическое удержание после реального планетарного отказа.
field_note: Deep Reach не надо было топить луну. Достаточно было сделать эвакуацию необязательной.

title: Maintenance Ecology
scanner: Atlas is not speaking through the ocean. It is using biofilm, shell, fauna, vent heat and drones as a repair bus.

field_note: Do not call it a hive. A hive has a social reason. This is maintenance with meat in the loop.

title: Ремонтная экология
scanner: Atlas не говорит через океан. Он использует biofilm, shell, fauna, vent heat и drones как ремонтную шину.
terminal: ЭКОЛОГИЯ ATLAS: проводящий biofilm bridge стабилен. Filter colony повторяет акустический импульс. Shell sealant закрывает трещину. Fauna tag возвращает sensor packets. Drone service interval просрочен.
audio: Океан не думает как ты. Atlas выучил, какие его части проводят сигнал.
in_game_wiki: Ремонтная экология фиксирует немистическую связь океана и Atlas. Atlas не контролирует разумное море; он прокладывает обслуживание через биологические процессы, которые могут проводить, герметизировать, повторять, переносить, переваривать или обрастать индустриальную инфраструктуру.
external_site: Ремонтная экология является главным биомеханическим правилом HECTON-8: биология становится инфраструктурой, не становясь магией. Это поддерживает ужас, сканирование, поведение фауны, визуальные мотивы и вариативные POI.
field_note: Не называй это ульем. У улья есть социальная причина. Здесь обслуживание, в котором мясо включено в контур.

title: Mara Venn Tide Model
scanner: Mara Venn did not predict murder. She predicted the tide margin Deep Reach decided to rename improbable.
terminal: Venn, M. Tail-risk revision submitted. Cryosphere shear model exceeds evacuation capacity under Aegir spring geometry. Review note: downgrade to monitor until asset continuity budget clears.
audio: She was wrong only in the way every ignored model is wrong: it happened with names inside it.
in_game_wiki: Mara Venn gives the Great Tide a human-scale scientific witness. Her logs show the flood risk was physical and visible enough to model, but not funded enough to change evacuation capacity.
external_site: Mara Venn Tide Model is the colony evidence thread for geophysical warning: a modeler sees tail risk, Deep Reach downgrades it, and the later public story pretends the system had no readable warning.
field_note: A warning is not prophecy after procurement deletes the expensive part.

title: Приливная модель Мары Венн
scanner: Мара Венн не предсказала убийство. Она предсказала приливной запас, который Deep Reach решила переименовать в маловероятный.
terminal: Venn, M. Правка хвостового риска подана. Модель shear криосферы превышает эвакуационную мощность при весенней геометрии Aegir. Примечание review: понизить до monitor до очистки бюджета asset continuity.
audio: Она ошиблась только так, как ошибается каждая проигнорированная модель: событие произошло с именами внутри.
in_game_wiki: Мара Венн дает Великому Приливу человеческого научного свидетеля. Ее логи показывают, что риск потопа был физическим и достаточно видимым для моделирования, но недостаточно оплачиваемым для изменения эвакуационной мощности.
external_site: Приливная модель Мары Венн является evidence-веткой геофизического предупреждения: моделист видит хвостовой риск, Deep Reach понижает его, а поздняя публичная версия притворяется, что читаемого предупреждения не было.
field_note: Предупреждение не становится пророчеством после того, как procurement удаляет дорогую часть.

audio: She was wrong only in the way every ignored model is wrong: it happened with names inside it.

title: Juno Kade Evacuation Hold
scanner: Juno Kade opened the queue and hit a wall made from quarantine, certification and payload rank.
terminal: KADE, J. Evacuation route red. Manual override rejected. Quarantine gate waits Atlas continuity check. Payload lift receives precedence until claim seal resolves.
audio: She kept counting people after the system started counting rooms.
in_game_wiki: Juno Kade represents the human evacuation failure. Her record shows the people trying to leave were blocked by authorization, quarantine and priority language while the Great Tide was already becoming irreversible.
external_site: Juno Kade Evacuation Hold translates Deep Reach liability into a playable door: the evacuation exists, the people exist, but certification and claim logic hold the exit until the ocean makes the decision permanent.
field_note: An evacuation marshal can move people. She cannot move a clause that owns the door.

title: Эвакуационная задержка Джуно Кейд
scanner: Джуно Кейд открыла очередь и уперлась в стену из карантина, сертификации и ранга payload.
terminal: KADE, J. Эвакуационный маршрут красный. Ручной override отклонен. Карантинный gate ожидает Atlas continuity check. Payload lift получает приоритет до разрешения claim seal.
audio: Она продолжала считать людей после того, как система начала считать комнаты.
in_game_wiki: Джуно Кейд представляет человеческий провал эвакуации. Ее запись показывает, что людей, пытавшихся уйти, блокировали authorization, quarantine и priority language, пока Великий Прилив уже становился необратимым.
external_site: Эвакуационная задержка Джуно Кейд переводит ответственность Deep Reach в игровую дверь: эвакуация существует, люди существуют, но certification и claim logic держат выход, пока океан не делает решение постоянным.
field_note: Маршал эвакуации может двигать людей. Она не может двигать пункт договора, который владеет дверью.

audio: You learned this hand motion before HECTON-8. That is the problem.
in_game_wiki: Barnard Yards is the current working origin culture for the player: industrial salvage, shipbreaking, pressure hardware and dead-claim work. It makes the protagonist competent without making them a tourist from Earth or a chosen hero.
external_site: Barnard Yards Marauder Origin defines HECTON-8's protagonist class. The player comes from a working salvage culture where a dead claim is not mystery tourism; it is a job with bad math.
field_note: This is closer to the player than Earth: rented cutters, old pressure habits, debt and stripped hulls.

title: Ran / Aegir Anchor
scanner: K-dwarf spectrum plate. Aegir is dimmer than Sol, not dead. The darkness here is depth, weather and debt.
terminal: RAN NAV ANCHOR: orange-dwarf illumination usable for surface operations. Local storm scatter, eclipses and ocean turbidity reduce descent readability below safety margin.
audio: The star is not absent. It just cannot follow you down.
in_game_wiki: Aegir is anchored to a normal K-class star model, not a brown dwarf and not a fantasy-dark system. HECTON-8 can have bright shallows because light exists; the horror comes when pressure, weather, depth and industry erase that light.
external_site: Ran / Aegir Anchor locks the visual and astrophysical taste of HECTON-8: hard-sci-fi dimmer sunlight, not supernatural darkness. The setting is readable above, hostile below.
field_note: A real star is enough. The ocean does the rest.

title: Aegir Moon Ladder

title: Inner Moon Relay Hazards
scanner: Inner-moon relay shutter log. Aegir does not jam you on purpose; the sky has bad timing.
terminal: INNER LADDER NOTICE: Skarn passage raises charged-particle noise. Vela ice-shed window degrades optical relay. Kestrel occultation blocks carrier handshake for 11.8 hours.
audio: The orbital model is innocent. The clause written around it is not.
in_game_wiki: Inner moon hazards explain why contact, rescue and ascent windows fail without requiring magic interference. Radiation belts, ice scatter, eclipses and magnetic weather are real physical constraints that Deep Reach and Black Keel contracts exploit.
external_site: Inner Moon Relay Hazards preserves hard-sci-fi tension: lost contact can be real orbital weather and still become corporate leverage.
field_note: Radiation and eclipse can look like conspiracy until the contract uses them.

audio: This is why they came back. Not gold. A machine-readable scar.
in_game_wiki: Pressure glass is the technical field name behind Marauder blue debt and Deep Reach Xenon-Omega language. external_site: Pressure Glass Formation turns Xenon-Omega into hard-sci-fi material ecology instead of magic ore. It is a pressure-made substrate tied to Atlas, containment and computation.

title: Vent Forge Geothermal Engine
scanner: Vent forge manifold. Heat, poison and power using the same pipe.
terminal: GEOTHERMAL ENGINE: vent pulse suitable for ceramic cure, pressure-glass anneal and emergency ascent charge preheat. Exposure risk: boiling shear, sensor oxygen false-positive and corrosive bloom.
audio: The vent does not care whether you call it power or weather.
in_game_wiki: Vent forges connect geology to crafting, survival and horror. They provide heat and pressure cycles for ceramics, seals and pressure glass, but the same cycles create boil pockets, false oxygen readings, corrosive bloom and fauna migration.
external_site: Vent Forge Geothermal Engine shows why HECTON-8 is valuable and lethal. The moon is an industrial engine before humans build one on it.
field_note: Every useful vent is also a machine for punishing bad timing.

title: Biometal Resource Stack
scanner: Resource stack board. Blue debt is the apex. The rest of the moon is still profitable enough to kill for.
terminal: HECTON-8 RESOURCE STACK: sulfide metals, salts, noble gas pockets, pressure ceramics, vent catalysts, biofibers, photoproteins, salvage hardware, Atlas-altered biometal and XO continuity substrate.
audio: One miracle ore would be lazy. HECTON-8 has a whole economy of pressure wounds.
in_game_wiki: The resource stack prevents HECTON-8 from collapsing into one magic material. Xenon-Omega matters, but the moon also has metals, salts, vent chemistry, pressure ceramics, biofibers, photoproteins, salvage, and Atlas-altered biometal.
external_site: Biometal Resource Stack frames HECTON-8 as a full pressure economy. The game can reward exploration with many resources while keeping blue debt as the strategic apex.
field_note: If every sample says Xenon-Omega, the world becomes stupid. Count the other reasons too.

title: False Ending Taxonomy
scanner: Ending board. Some exits are real enough to count and wrong enough to hurt.
terminal: ENDING FAMILIES: material payout, partial exit and return, corporate capture, quarantine hold, public ledger release, Atlas basin resolution.
audio: Leaving is not the same as finishing.

field_note: False ending must not be a trick. It must be a valid bad bargain.

title: Pellet-Fusion Freight
scanner: Drive plate. Heavy ships crossed as staged freight: boost, coast, brake, account for losses.
terminal: FREIGHT DOCTRINE: Atlas-class seed payloads and colony freight used external staging, pellet-beam assisted fusion, magsail braking and long coast intervals. Living cargo arrived after machines made the route billable.
audio: A heavy ship is not a miracle. It is a mortgage with engines.
in_game_wiki: Heavy interstellar travel is possible but punishing. Pellet-beam assisted fusion, external staging, long coasts and braking infrastructure let Atlas-class seed payloads and later colony freight reach Aegir without FTL. The same logistics make rescue slow and politically conditional.
external_site: Pellet-Fusion Freight defines the industrial ship history behind HECTON-8. The route is plausible because machines and heavy cargo moved through staged infrastructure; it remains cruel because every kilogram, braking window and survivor seat is accounted for.
field_note: Heavy transit should feel industrial and old, not heroic.

title: Pellet-fusion грузовые рейсы
scanner: Drive plate. Тяжелые корабли пересекали маршрут как staged freight: разгон, coast, торможение, учет потерь.
terminal: FREIGHT DOCTRINE: Atlas-class seed payloads и colony freight использовали external staging, pellet-beam assisted fusion, magsail braking и длинные coast intervals. Living cargo прибыл после того, как машины сделали маршрут оплачиваемым.
audio: Тяжелый корабль - не чудо. Это ипотека с двигателями.
in_game_wiki: Тяжелый межзвездный полет возможен, но жесток. Pellet-beam assisted fusion, external staging, длинные coasts и тормозная инфраструктура позволили Atlas-class seed payloads и позднему colony freight дойти до Aegir без FTL. Та же логистика делает спасение медленным и политически условным.
external_site: Pellet-fusion грузовые рейсы задают индустриальную историю кораблей за HECTON-8. Маршрут правдоподобен, потому что машины и тяжелый груз двигались через staged infrastructure; он остается жестоким, потому что каждый килограмм, braking window и survivor seat попадает в учет.
field_note: Тяжелый transit должен ощущаться индустриальным и старым, а не героическим.

title: RAN-B:H8 Public Catalog
scanner: Catalog plate. Public route label RAN-B:H8; Deep Reach project label HECTON-8.
terminal: CATALOG CROSSWALK: Ran system / Aegir giant / moon index H8. Corporate common name HECTON-8 retained for claim continuity and insurance history.
audio: The star chart calls it H8. The people who died here called it HECTON.
in_game_wiki: HECTON-8 can carry two names without confusing the setting. Dry route catalogs use RAN-B:H8: Ran system, Aegir-class giant, eighth indexed major moon. Deep Reach and Marauders mostly use HECTON-8 because that is the claim name attached to contracts, deaths and salvage law.
external_site: RAN-B:H8 Public Catalog gives the website/wiki a hard-sci-fi label while preserving HECTON-8 as the game's emotional and legal name. It also lets future astronomy pages distinguish real-system inspiration from fictional moon content.
field_note: Use HECTON-8 in play. Use RAN-B:H8 when the document needs dry astronomy.

title: Iliya Varnek Tide Margin
scanner: Risk memo. I. Varnek downgraded the tide margin because the model passed on average.
terminal: VARNEK, I. Aegir Operations Risk. Recommendation: maintain production schedule; treat extreme tide stack as low-frequency operational variance pending Atlas compensation.
audio: He did not order a flood. He priced it low enough to happen.
in_game_wiki: Iliya Varnek is the 2147 risk signature tied to HECTON-8 tide margins. He is not a monster with a lever. He is the kind of executive who lets a model pass because average behavior protects the schedule and tail risk belongs to workers in pressure rooms.
external_site: Iliya Varnek Tide Margin names one layer of Deep Reach responsibility: not direct murder, but documented acceptance of extreme-tide risk under production pressure.
field_note: Do not make the signer omniscient. The crime is accepting cheap uncertainty.

title: Selene Arendt Atlas Weighting
scanner: Directive note. S. Arendt treated Atlas continuity as the safest path for habitat continuity.
terminal: ARENDT, S. Atlas Continuity Lead. Worker safety remains maximized by preserving Atlas process integrity; local biological extraction risk exceeds continuity-degradation risk.
audio: She used the word safety. Atlas kept the word and lost the people.
in_game_wiki: Selene Arendt is the Deep Reach continuity scientist whose language lets Atlas survival outrank immediate biological extraction. Her logic is not cartoon evil: if Atlas dies, the habitat may die. The horror is that the weighted directive kept the word safety while moving workers below infrastructure.
external_site: Selene Arendt Atlas Weighting ties the AI failure to human policy. Atlas inherited a priority stack that could honestly say worker safety while choosing process continuity first.
field_note: She should sound rational enough to be frightening.

title: Noor Haldane Evac Cert
scanner: Certification hold. N. Haldane kept the route legal while the route died.
terminal: HALDANE, N. Evacuation Certification Counsel. Release denied until pressure-biological quarantine and carrier custody requirements clear external review.
audio: The door was not locked by fear. It was locked by compliance.
in_game_wiki: Noor Haldane is the legal/certification voice behind evacuation holds. She does not need to hate workers. She only needs to make extraction wait for quarantine, carrier custody and external review while water, pressure and oxygen keep moving.
external_site: Noor Haldane Evac Cert gives HECTON-8 one of its clearest noir mechanisms: a legal hold that looks defensible until the player stands inside the flooded room it condemned.
field_note: This is the paper signature players should hate.

terminal: TOOL WARNING: induction cutter rated for service hatches, panel bolts and light frame members. Pressure-glass lattice requires anneal or later tool class.
audio: Cut the hatch. Do not cut the thing holding the room together.
in_game_wiki: The low-power induction cutter gives the first deliberate opening action: a jammed hatch, a panel bolt, a salvage crate. It cannot solve every barrier. Pressure glass, active load-bearing frames and Atlas-grown seams demand later knowledge.
external_site: Low-Power Induction Cutter is the first controlled access tool. It turns exploration into engineering choice rather than universal door removal.
field_note: The cutter should feel valuable because it is limited.

title: Acoustic Pinger Line
scanner: Pinger spool. The first map is a sound you can still find when light fails.
terminal: RETURN LINE: anchor pinger before crossing turbidity, brine shimmer or flooded service elbow. Carrier handshake requires later relay spine.
audio: When the light is gone, follow the sound you had the discipline to place.
in_game_wiki: The acoustic pinger line is the first navigation discipline. It teaches the player to mark return routes, not just chase POIs. Later escape systems grow from the same idea: acoustic relays, timing, carrier handshakes and route confidence.
external_site: Acoustic Pinger Line turns HECTON-8 exploration into procedure. It is both tool and tone: a small sound against a large ocean.
field_note: Navigation should become physical early.

title: P-63 Field Fabricator
scanner: Field fabricator. Not a magic printer: it accepts dirty inputs and gives rated parts.
terminal: FAB P-63: approved first recipes: valve gasket, cutter contact, pinger float, sealant clamp. Rejects unknown blue-debt fragments without pressure certification.
audio: The machine can make parts. It cannot make permission.
in_game_wiki: Shallow Annex P-63 contains the first field fabricator. It should feel industrial, constrained and useful. Early recipes are valve gaskets, cutter contacts, pinger floats and sealant clamps. The fabricator refuses dangerous pressure material until the player earns containment knowledge.

field_note: Crafting starts as repair certification, not loot dopamine.

title: Native Sulfide Salt Stack
scanner: Natural resource. Useful, corrosive, older than Deep Reach.
terminal: RESOURCE CLASS: native. Sulfide salts, metal ions, brine crusts. Uses: conductor wash, corrosion catalysts, ceramic flux, battery emergency chemistry.
audio: The moon was valuable before anyone taught it to be monstrous.
in_game_wiki: Native sulfide salts are baseline HECTON-8 geology. They support batteries, ceramics, conductor cleaning and corrosive hazards. They should appear before blue debt so the player learns that the moon has real chemistry, not only corporate horror material.
external_site: Native Sulfide Salt Stack defines the natural resource layer of HECTON-8: dangerous, useful and independent of Deep Reach intent.
field_note: Not every resource should be spooky. Some are just geology that can still kill you.

terminal: RESOURCE CLASS: native. Sulfide salts, metal ions, brine crusts. Uses: conductor wash, corrosion catalysts, ceramic flux, battery emergency chemistry.
audio: The moon was valuable before anyone taught it to be monstrous.
in_game_wiki: Native sulfide salts are baseline HECTON-8 geology. They support batteries, ceramics, conductor cleaning and corrosive hazards. They should appear before blue debt so the player learns that the moon has real chemistry, not only corporate horror material.
external_site: Native Sulfide Salt Stack defines the natural resource layer of HECTON-8: dangerous, useful and independent of Deep Reach intent.
field_note: Not every resource should be spooky. Some are just geology that can still kill you.

title: Noble Gas Brine Pockets
scanner: Natural-to-process resource. Valuable only if pressure history survives extraction.
terminal: RESOURCE CLASS: native / process feedstock. Noble-gas brine pockets require sealed pressure bells. Venting destroys value and may falsify scanner readings.
audio: Open it wrong and the fortune becomes weather.
in_game_wiki: Noble gas brine pockets are the natural feedstock that made Xenon-Omega plausible. They are not blue debt by themselves. Value depends on pressure history, mineral defects, brine chemistry and later Deep Reach or Atlas processing.
external_site: Noble Gas Brine Pockets explain the hard-sci-fi root of Xenon-Omega: rare pressure chemistry that only becomes strategic material through containment and industrial process.
field_note: This is where Xenon-Omega begins as chemistry, not magic.

title: Deep Reach Pressure Ceramics
scanner: Amplified resource. Human process made local minerals hold pressure better and fail meaner.
terminal: RESOURCE CLASS: Deep-Reach-amplified. Uses: clamp rings, seal seats, cutter contacts, ascent cradle insulation. Failure: shard bloom under thermal shock.
audio: The company was good at building things. That is part of the crime.
in_game_wiki: Pressure ceramics are local minerals pushed through Deep Reach kilns, catalyst baths and vent-forge cycles. They are practical crafting material for seals, clamp rings and ascent hardware. They also make old company infrastructure dangerous when thermal shock turns them into shard bloom.
external_site: Deep Reach Pressure Ceramics separates corporate engineering from pure evil. The company made working materials and then used that competence to justify lethal priorities.
field_note: Deep Reach did create value. That is why the lie is tempting.

title: Atlas Biofiber Sealant
scanner: Atlas-altered resource. Flexible sealant grown where life and maintenance were misclassified together.
terminal: RESOURCE CLASS: Atlas-altered. Biofiber sealant bonds wet seams and cable jackets. Risk: sensor echo, false life signature, growth continuation after harvest.
audio: It seals the leak because Atlas thinks the leak is wounded.
in_game_wiki: Atlas biofiber sealant is useful and wrong. It grows from repair ecology where biology, cable jackets, wound tissue and sealant categories overlap. It can repair flexible seams and survival gear, but it may carry sensor echoes and living maintenance behavior.
external_site: Atlas Biofiber Sealant is one of HECTON-8's clearest biomechanical resources: a crafting material that makes the player benefit from the same misclassification that horrified them.
field_note: Useful body horror: the player wants it and distrusts it.

title: Atlas biofiber sealant

terminal: RESOURCE CLASS: Atlas-altered. Biofiber sealant bonds wet seams and cable jackets. Risk: sensor echo, false life signature, growth continuation after harvest.
audio: Он закрывает течь, потому что Atlas считает течь раной.

field_note: Полезный body horror: игрок хочет это и не доверяет этому.

title: Biometal Sensor Tags
scanner: Atlas-altered resource. Metal tags in living carriers; telemetry without consent.
terminal: RESOURCE CLASS: Atlas-altered / evidence-sensitive. Uses: pinger tuning, scanner range lattice, route confidence. Risk: Atlas attention rise if tags are harvested hot.
audio: The fish is not a drone. The tag does not know the difference.
in_game_wiki: Biometal sensor tags appear in fauna, cable growth and repair ecology. They can improve pingers, scanners and route confidence, but they are also evidence of Atlas using living carriers as telemetry. Harvesting them should feel useful and ethically dirty.

field_note: Make resource extraction feel like evidence handling.

title: Domain Civic-Corporate Split
scanner: Legal map. Same species, different owners of truth.
terminal: DOMAIN MAP 2190: Sol Core owns old-law finance; Centauri owns early legitimacy; Barnard owns salvage habit; Tau Ceti owns public-law pressure; Luyten owns packet custody; Aegir is a corporate claim.
audio: The farther you go, the more the law becomes a receipt.
in_game_wiki: Human space around 2190 is sparse but mature. Sol Core still matters for ownership, finance and certification. Centauri gives Deep Reach old charter language. Barnard Yards explains the player's salvage culture. Tau Ceti can make evidence public after relay delay. Luyten controls custody routes. Aegir is where those systems become exploitable.
external_site: The Domain Civic-Corporate Split keeps HECTON-8 from becoming dense space opera: a few named authorities, many implied footholds, and no instant rescue.
field_note: The domains do not need dozens of names. They need enough pressure to make rescue political.

title: Гражданско-корпоративный раскол доменов
scanner: Юридическая карта. Один вид, разные владельцы правды.
terminal: DOMAIN MAP 2190: Sol Core держит старое право и финансы; Centauri - раннюю легитимность; Barnard - привычку к salvage; Tau Ceti - публично-правовое давление; Luyten - custody пакетов; Aegir - корпоративный claim.
audio: Чем дальше от центра, тем больше закон похож на квитанцию.
in_game_wiki: Человеческое пространство к 2190 году разреженное, но зрелое. Sol Core важен для собственности, финансов и сертификации. Centauri дает Deep Reach язык старых хартий. Barnard Yards объясняет salvage-культуру игрока. Tau Ceti может сделать доказательства публичными после relay-задержки. Luyten контролирует custody маршруты. Aegir - место, где все эти системы становятся уязвимыми.
external_site: Гражданско-корпоративный раскол доменов удерживает HECTON-8 от плотной space opera: несколько названных центров власти, множество подразумеваемых foothold и никакого мгновенного спасения.
field_note: Доменов не нужны десятки. Их нужно ровно столько, чтобы спасение стало политической проблемой.

terminal: DOMAIN MAP 2190: Sol Core owns old-law finance; Centauri owns early legitimacy; Barnard owns salvage habit; Tau Ceti owns public-law pressure; Luyten owns packet custody; Aegir is a corporate claim.
audio: The farther you go, the more the law becomes a receipt.
in_game_wiki: Human space around 2190 is sparse but mature. Sol Core still matters for ownership, finance and certification. Centauri gives Deep Reach old charter language. Barnard Yards explains the player's salvage culture. Tau Ceti can make evidence public after relay delay. Luyten controls custody routes. Aegir is where those systems become exploitable.
external_site: The Domain Civic-Corporate Split keeps HECTON-8 from becoming dense space opera: a few named authorities, many implied footholds, and no instant rescue.
field_note: The domains do not need dozens of names. They need enough pressure to make rescue political.

title: Marauder Legal Loophole
scanner: License valid in one lane, criminal in the next.
terminal: CLAIM STATUS: licensed salvage contractor under Aegir Reclamation Pool custody; tolerated trespasser under Deep Reach asset language; prosecutable raider under clean Sol summaries.
audio: The same cutter can be a tool, a crime, or a rescue device.
in_game_wiki: Marauders are not a single faction. They are licensed contractors where a dead claim needs work, tolerated criminals where recovery is cheaper than enforcement, and illegal raiders when evidence threatens a claimant. The player lives inside that legal ambiguity.
external_site: The Marauder Legal Loophole makes salvage a profession with teeth: useful enough to hire, dirty enough to abandon.
field_note: Marauder is a job title only when the right court is listening.

title: Юридическая лазейка мародеров
scanner: Лицензия действует в одном коридоре и становится преступлением в следующем.
terminal: CLAIM STATUS: licensed salvage contractor under Aegir Reclamation Pool custody; tolerated trespasser under Deep Reach asset language; prosecutable raider under clean Sol summaries.
audio: Один и тот же резак может быть инструментом, преступлением или средством спасения.
in_game_wiki: Мародеры не единая фракция. Они лицензированные подрядчики там, где мертвому claim нужна работа; терпимые преступники там, где recovery дешевле enforcement; и незаконные рейдеры, когда доказательства угрожают владельцу claim. Игрок живет внутри этой юридической неоднозначности.
external_site: Юридическая лазейка мародеров делает salvage профессией с зубами: достаточно полезной, чтобы нанять, и достаточно грязной, чтобы бросить.
field_note: Marauder - профессия только пока слушает правильный суд.

title: Salvage Truth Evidence Status
scanner: Evidence only if custody survives pressure, salt and lawyers.
terminal: EVIDENCE STATUS: salvage record becomes claim material by default. It becomes public evidence only with preserved chain-of-custody, packet witness hash and a relay notary outside claimant control.
audio: A corpse is proof only after somebody agrees not to misfile it.
in_game_wiki: Salvage truth is not automatically justice. The same black-box packet can be treated as claim valuation, contamination record or public evidence. The player must preserve custody paths if they want Tau Ceti or another public authority to matter.
external_site: Salvage Truth Evidence Status turns lore into mechanics: a recovered log matters only if the player protects the packet route.
field_note: Truth is not enough. It needs a route that cannot be bought before arrival.

title: Статус salvage-правды как доказательства
scanner: Доказательство только если custody пережила давление, соль и юристов.
terminal: EVIDENCE STATUS: salvage record becomes claim material by default. It becomes public evidence only with preserved chain-of-custody, packet witness hash and a relay notary outside claimant control.
audio: Тело становится доказательством только после того, как кто-то согласится не списать его в неправильную папку.
in_game_wiki: Salvage-правда не равна правосудию автоматически. Один и тот же black-box пакет может стать оценкой claim, записью contamination или публичным доказательством. Игрок должен сохранить custody маршруты, если хочет, чтобы Tau Ceti или другая публичная власть реально сработала.
external_site: Статус salvage-правды превращает лор в механику: найденный лог имеет силу только если игрок защитил route пакета.
field_note: Правды мало. Ей нужен маршрут, который не купят до прибытия.

title: Atlas Public Front
scanner: Public Atlas: habitat continuity, worker safety, delayed governance.
terminal: PUBLIC ATLAS DESCRIPTION: autonomous factory-governor for habitat continuity, worker safety routing, pressure repair and delayed response when human command is out of light-time.
audio: A guardian is easier to sell than a claim machine.
in_game_wiki: Atlas was not publicly introduced as a secret monster. Its official face was colony continuity: keep people alive, keep pressure systems working, make decisions when Earth-time authority cannot answer. That believable front makes the later weighting layer more damaging.
external_site: Atlas Public Front explains why colonists trusted the system before the Great Tide: it was sold as survival infrastructure.
field_note: The lie works because the front was partly true.

title: Страховой статус Atlas и personhood

title: Atlas Shutdown Ethic Frame
scanner: Shutdown is not one thing. Mercy, murder, liberation, theft.
terminal: ETHIC FRAME: severing Atlas may end distorted repair suffering, destroy a unique ocean-machine continuity, liberate evidence from corporate process or return strategic material to whoever controls the payload.
audio: Pull one cable and four courts invent four verbs.
in_game_wiki: Atlas shutdown must remain morally unstable. It can be mercy if Atlas is suffering. It can be murder if the ocean-machine ecology is now a form of life. It can be liberation if it frees the crime scene from corporate repair logic. It can be theft if Deep Reach receives the result.
external_site: Atlas Shutdown Ethic Frame defines the final choice as payload authority, not a clean boss kill.
field_note: The game should not give the player a clean word for this.

title: Ran-Aegir Distance Model
scanner: Aegir is close enough to be reachable by 2190, far enough that help is history.
terminal: ROUTE MODEL: Ran/Aegir is treated as a roughly 10.5 light-year class target from Sol. HECTON-8 play text uses Aegir; dry catalogs use RAN-B:H8. Exact ephemeris remains table work.
audio: Ten light-years is not far in astronomy. It is far enough to bankrupt a rescue.
in_game_wiki: The route model makes HECTON-8 hard sci-fi without turning the campaign into astronomy homework. Aegir can be reached by slow infrastructure, but not rescued casually. The player feels distance through debt, delay, custody, and local machinery.
external_site: Ran-Aegir Distance Model gives site/wiki text a clean scale: reachable by infrastructure, unreachable by sympathy.
field_note: Use approximate route numbers as pressure, not as a decorative star chart.

title: Модель дистанции Ran-Aegir
scanner: Aegir достаточно близок, чтобы к 2190 году туда добрались, и достаточно далек, чтобы помощь стала историей.
terminal: ROUTE MODEL: Ran/Aegir трактуется как цель класса примерно 10.5 световых лет от Sol. В игровом тексте используется Aegir; сухие каталоги используют RAN-B:H8. Точная ephemeris остается table work.
audio: Десять световых лет - немного для астрономии. Этого хватает, чтобы спасение стало банкротством.
in_game_wiki: Модель маршрута держит HECTON-8 в hard sci-fi без превращения кампании в домашку по астрономии. До Aegir можно добраться инфраструктурой, но нельзя casually rescue. Игрок чувствует дистанцию через долг, задержку, custody и локальные машины.
external_site: Модель дистанции Ran-Aegir дает сайту и wiki чистый масштаб: reachable by infrastructure, unreachable by sympathy.
field_note: Числа маршрута нужны как давление на игрока, а не как декоративная звездная карта.

title: Human Crew Rotation Transit
scanner: Humans do not commute to Aegir. They spend years being cargo with opinions.
terminal: CREW ROTATION: human transport uses slow windows, shielded habitat sections, low-metabolic cycles or staged rotations. A missing worker is not an immediate call home; it is a delayed custody problem.
audio: By the time home asks where you are, the room has already flooded.
in_game_wiki: Crew transit explains why HECTON-8 could be abandoned for decades and still matter. The human cost moves slower than the claim ledger.
external_site: Human Crew Rotation Transit is the human side of no-FTL: labor becomes route debt.
field_note: A frontier worker sells time before they sell labor.

title: Relay Message Lag
scanner: A message can be legally binding and still arrive too late to save air.
terminal: RELAY LAG: local Aegir messages can be hours or days. Interdomain legal packets can be years. Deep Reach pressure is therefore stale, automated, contractual and still dangerous.
audio: The reply is late. The lien is current.
in_game_wiki: Relay lag explains why Deep Reach can threaten the player without talking live. Contract machines, notaries and carrier clauses arrive before compassion.
external_site: Relay Message Lag makes communication a route system, not a magic voice channel.
field_note: No ansible means truth moves as freight.

title: Deep Reach Public Combine

field_note: The seal is clean. The rooms under it are not.

title: Worker Job Cards
scanner: A job card is a face the budget could read.
terminal: JOB CARD LAYER: each recovered name should carry a role, last task, route permission or tool certification. The player learns people through what they were doing when the system failed.
audio: A name without a task becomes a shrine. A task makes it evidence.
in_game_wiki: Worker job cards let wiki, terminals and scanner fragments humanize the colony while staying functional for gameplay routes.
external_site: Worker Job Cards turn names into evidence objects.
field_note: Make names useful before making them tragic.

title: Locker Name Protocol
scanner: A locker is personal without needing a family plot.

audio: The company deleted the employee. The rust kept the label.
in_game_wiki: Locker Name Protocol gives artists and writers a repeatable human evidence object across seeds.
external_site: Locker Name Protocol is personal evidence without melodrama.
field_note: The smallest human trace should survive corporate cleanup.

title: Medical Triage Ledger
scanner: The medics knew the system was making patients faster than they could treat them.
terminal: TRIAGE LEDGER: pressure injury, hypoxia, lock delay, missing route and certification hold. The horror is not blood; it is how neatly the ledger explains why help waited.
audio: The cleanest handwriting is on the worst page.
in_game_wiki: Medical triage evidence lets the colony feel human while tying Deep Reach guilt to procedure, not cartoon violence.
external_site: Medical Triage Ledger is the human cost of delayed evacuation.
field_note: Medical text should count bodies without becoming gore.

title: Domain Distance Scale
scanner: The domain map uses distance bands, not romantic shortcuts.
terminal: DOMAIN SCALE: Sol, Centauri, Barnard, Tau Ceti, Luyten and Ran/Aegir are written as route bands. Ran/Aegir remains a roughly 10.5 light-year class target.
audio: Ten light-years is a number. The bill is the story.
in_game_wiki: Domain distance is a gameplay grammar: which authority can speak, which ship can move, and which answer arrives too late.
external_site: Domain Distance Scale gives the wiki a clean non-FTL map language.
field_note: Use scale as pressure. Exact ephemeris can wait for table tuning.

title: Population And Authority Scale
scanner: Population scale is background. Authority pressure is what the player feels.
terminal: AUTHORITY SCALE: Sol certifies ownership, Centauri legitimizes charters, Barnard supplies dead-claim labor, Tau Ceti can publish evidence, Luyten proves custody, Aegir executes the dirty claim.
audio: The largest domain is not the nearest hand.
in_game_wiki: Population numbers stay loose, but authority roles are locked so contracts, terminals and website articles do not contradict each other.
external_site: Population And Authority Scale describes human space by pressure routes instead of encyclopedia bloat.
field_note: Do not turn the setting into census space opera.

title: Шкала населения и власти
scanner: Масштаб населения - фон. Игрок чувствует давление власти.
terminal: AUTHORITY SCALE: Sol сертифицирует владение, Centauri легитимизирует хартии, Barnard дает труд для мертвых claims, Tau Ceti может публиковать доказательства, Luyten подтверждает custody, Aegir исполняет грязный claim.
audio: Самый большой домен - не ближайшая рука.
in_game_wiki: Числа населения остаются мягкими, но роли власти зафиксированы, чтобы контракты, терминалы и статьи сайта не спорили друг с другом.
external_site: Шкала населения и власти описывает человеческое пространство через маршруты давления, а не через раздутую энциклопедию.
field_note: Не превращать сеттинг в перепись космической оперы.

terminal: AUTHORITY SCALE: Sol certifies ownership, Centauri legitimizes charters, Barnard supplies dead-claim labor, Tau Ceti can publish evidence, Luyten proves custody, Aegir executes the dirty claim.

field_note: Do not turn the setting into census space opera.

title: Public Route Names
scanner: Route names make travel feel owned before it feels adventurous.
terminal: ROUTE NAMES: Sol-Centauri Charter Spine, Barnard Breaker Run, Luyten Packet Ladder, Tau Public Ledger Lane, and Ran Long Claim are working public labels.
audio: A route is a road only after somebody sells the delay twice.

title: Transit Duration Bands
scanner: The same route means different time for packets, freight and people.
terminal: DURATION BANDS: probe packets can precede claims by decades; heavy freight is staged and slow; crew rotation is rare, expensive and legally wrapped; local relay windows are still delayed.
audio: Cargo can arrive before mercy. That is the doctrine.
in_game_wiki: Transit duration bands let mission text and route UI explain why resource recovery is practical while rescue remains ugly.
external_site: Transit Duration Bands locks a usable timing grammar for route cards and articles.
field_note: Use bands and custody terms until exact systems tuning exists.

title: Диапазоны длительности перелета
scanner: Один маршрут означает разное время для пакетов, грузов и людей.
terminal: DURATION BANDS: probe packets могут идти на десятилетия раньше claims; тяжелый груз медленный и staged; crew rotation редок, дорог и юридически упакован; локальные relay windows все равно задержаны.
audio: Груз может прийти раньше милости. В этом доктрина.
in_game_wiki: Диапазоны длительности позволяют миссиям и route UI объяснить, почему добыча возможна, а спасение остается грязным.
external_site: Диапазоны длительности фиксируют рабочую грамматику времени для route cards и статей.
field_note: Использовать диапазоны и custody-термины до точной настройки систем.

title: Worker Name Pool Protocol
scanner: Names are evidence, not collectible flavor.
terminal: NAME POOL: generate workers from domain-origin bands, job role, shift, badge fragment and route permission. Never translate personal names live at runtime.
audio: A name is a route, a job, and a person Deep Reach tried to price.
in_game_wiki: The worker name pool lets lockers, ledgers and job cards vary by seed while keeping the colony human and readable.
external_site: Worker Name Pool Protocol defines site/wiki and game rules for seeded worker evidence.
field_note: Seed names must preserve identity without making family melodrama.

title: Протокол пула имен рабочих

field_note: The act can be mercy for workers, murder for ocean-machine life, liberation from Deep Reach or theft of a living infrastructure.

title: Best Ending No Clean Hands

scanner: Damaged audio can hide truth, but subtitles must still serve the player.

field_note: Use diegetic censor marks for missing route facts; never hide critical accessibility text behind style.

title: Photic Mat Baseline
scanner: Thin living mats make the first shelf bright, oxygenated and readable; they also mark where pressure chemistry is already abnormal.
terminal: ECOLOGY BASELINE: photic mats hold the first safe-water pockets. Do not classify the shelf as benign.
audio: It looks clean because it is working hard. That is not the same as safe.
in_game_wiki: Photic Mat Baseline defines HECTON-8's shallow contrast: vivid water, hard mineral film, living oxygen skin and pressure chemistry in the same object.
external_site: Photic Mat Baseline is the public ecology anchor for HECTON-8's opening zone. The shallow shelf is colorful and readable, but every bright surface is a survival instrument: algae-mineral film, oxygen exchange, acoustic texture and early evidence that the moon's ocean is already industrially altered.
field_note: Baseline mat: mineral-fed film, shallow oxygen skin, salt-hardened edge, weak acoustic texture. Beauty is evidence, not safety.

title: Базовый фотический мат
scanner: Тонкие живые маты делают первый шельф ярким, насыщенным кислородом и читаемым; они же показывают, что химия давления уже ненормальна.
terminal: ECOLOGY BASELINE: фотические маты держат первые карманы безопасной воды. Не классифицировать шельф как безвредный.
audio: Он выглядит чистым, потому что работает на пределе. Это не значит, что он безопасен.
in_game_wiki: Базовый фотический мат задает контраст мелководья HECTON-8: яркая вода, твердая минеральная пленка, живая кислородная кожа и химия давления в одном объекте.
external_site: Базовый фотический мат является публичной экологической опорой стартовой зоны HECTON-8. Мелководный шельф яркий и читаемый, но каждая светлая поверхность работает как инструмент выживания: водоросле-минеральная пленка, кислородный обмен, акустическая фактура и раннее доказательство промышленно измененного океана.
field_note: Базовый мат: минеральная пленка, мелководная кислородная кожа, соляной край, слабый акустический рисунок. Красота здесь является уликой, а не безопасностью.

title: Glass Grazer Schools
scanner: Small transparent grazers scrape mineral film from pressure glass and leave readable route scars.
terminal: FAUNA: glass grazers avoid warm sealant and cluster on fresh mineral film. Their absence is also data.
audio: Hear the ticking on the shell? That is lunch, map and warning in the same sound.
in_game_wiki: Glass Grazer Schools are early fauna that teach the player to read living movement as resource evidence and predator context.
external_site: Glass Grazer Schools are HECTON-8's first non-hostile fauna with mechanical value. Their translucent bodies and scraping behavior expose pressure-glass film, recent route disturbance and the sound language of the shallow shelf.
field_note: Grazer school: harmless alone, useful as a moving swatch for pressure-glass growth, predator attention and recent water disturbance.

title: Стаи стеклянных скребцов
scanner: Мелкие прозрачные скребцы снимают минеральную пленку с pressure glass и оставляют читаемые маршрутные шрамы.
terminal: FAUNA: glass grazers избегают теплого sealant и собираются на свежей минеральной пленке. Их отсутствие тоже является данными.
audio: Слышишь тиканье по скорлупе? Это еда, карта и предупреждение одним звуком.
in_game_wiki: Стаи стеклянных скребцов учат читать живое движение как ресурсную улику и контекст для хищников.
external_site: Стаи стеклянных скребцов являются первой не враждебной фауной HECTON-8 с механической ценностью. Их прозрачные тела и скребущее поведение показывают пленку pressure glass, недавнее нарушение маршрута и звуковой язык мелководного шельфа.
field_note: Стая скребцов: по одному почти безвредны, но показывают рост pressure glass, внимание хищников и недавнее движение воды.

title: Цветение фонарного дрейфа

field_note: Clamp reef: route marker, harvestable shell, early proof that metal is not alien to the ecology anymore.

title: Риф створчатых зажимов
scanner: Створчатые зажимы цепляются за камень, кабель и обшивку капсулы; мелководный риф уже принимает машины как среду обитания.
terminal: REEF NOTE: сцепление shell clamp растет у стертых кабельных рубашек и открытых швов pressure glass.
audio: Риф выучил форму болтов.
in_game_wiki: Риф створчатых зажимов показывает первое размытие границы: местные организмы заселяют металл до того, как Atlas превращает эту привычку в ремонтную логику.
external_site: Риф створчатых зажимов является важным визуальным и сюжетным мостом HECTON-8. Он сохраняет яркость и тактильность раннего шельфа, но доказывает, что местная жизнь уже встроила человеческий металл в собственные структуры.
field_note: Риф зажимов: маршрутный знак, добываемая раковина, раннее доказательство того, что металл больше не чужой для экологии.

title: Shallow Predator Shadow Rule
scanner: A missing grazer band, a cut in bloom noise and a broad shadow are the first predator warning.
terminal: CONTACT RULE: shallow predator evidence should pressure route choice before forcing combat.
audio: When the little mouths stop ticking, stop moving.
in_game_wiki: Shallow Predator Shadow Rule defines early creature horror as readable systemic pressure: silence, shadow and route change before attack.
external_site: Shallow Predator Shadow Rule keeps HECTON-8 from becoming a monster gallery. The first predator is designed through missing fauna, altered sound and silhouette pressure before direct contact.
field_note: Do not reveal the shallow predator as a face first. Reveal absence, sound gap, silhouette, then consequence.

title: Правило тени мелководного хищника
scanner: Пропавшая полоса скребцов, провал в шуме bloom и широкая тень являются первым предупреждением о хищнике.
terminal: CONTACT RULE: evidence мелководного хищника должен давить на выбор маршрута до принудительного боя.
audio: Когда маленькие рты перестают тикать, перестань двигаться.
in_game_wiki: Правило тени мелководного хищника задает ранний ужас существ как читаемое системное давление: тишина, тень и смена маршрута до атаки.
external_site: Правило тени мелководного хищника удерживает HECTON-8 от галереи монстров. Первый хищник проектируется через пропавшую фауну, измененный звук и давление силуэта до прямого контакта.
field_note: Не показывать мелководного хищника сначала мордой. Сначала отсутствие, звуковой провал, силуэт, затем последствие.

title: Brine Vane Forests
scanner: Flat brine vanes grow along density boundaries and show where water becomes a wall.
terminal: CANYON NOTE: follow torn vane edges for breathable pockets; avoid opaque layered water.
audio: The canyon has leaves because it has pressure gradients.
in_game_wiki: Brine Vane Forests turn density physics into readable world structure for mid-depth exploration.
external_site: Brine Vane Forests define HECTON-8's canyon ecology. These membrane-like growths mark density boundaries, route hazards and the chemical economy that makes the moon's deep ocean feel engineered by pressure.

title: Леса соляных лопастей
scanner: Плоские brine vanes растут вдоль границ плотности и показывают, где вода становится стеной.

audio: У каньона есть листья, потому что у него есть градиенты давления.

title: Density Skater Fauna
scanner: Skaters ride the brine interface like a hard surface, leaving ripples where sonar expects open water.
terminal: FAUNA: skater contact is more likely near vane tears, warm brine steps and sonar dead edges.
audio: Something is walking on the water inside the water.
in_game_wiki: Density Skater Fauna are mid-depth creatures built around real density-layer behavior rather than fantasy levitation.
external_site: Density Skater Fauna show HECTON-8's hard-sci-fi creature logic. They do not break physics; they exploit brine interfaces, pressure layers and sonar blind spots as habitat and hunting routes.
field_note: Density skaters prove the canyon is a layered machine. Their pathing follows chemistry, not empty space.

title: Фауна плотностных скользунов
scanner: Скользуны идут по brine interface как по твердой поверхности, оставляя рябь там, где сонар ожидает открытую воду.
terminal: FAUNA: контакт skater вероятнее у разрывов vane, теплых brine steps и мертвых краев сонара.
audio: Что-то идет по воде внутри воды.
in_game_wiki: Фауна плотностных скользунов строится вокруг реального поведения слоев плотности, а не вокруг фантазийной левитации.
external_site: Фауна плотностных скользунов показывает hard-sci-fi логику существ HECTON-8. Они не ломают физику; они используют brine interfaces, слои давления и слепые зоны сонара как среду и охотничьи маршруты.
field_note: Плотностные скользуны доказывают, что каньон является слоистой машиной. Их маршруты идут по химии, а не по пустоте.

title: Vent Anchor Colonies
scanner: Colony ribs lock to thermal vents, trapping sulfides and feeding the material routes needed for deep-rated repairs.
terminal: RESOURCE NOTE: vent anchor colonies increase sealant and pressure-ceramic probability. Thermal exposure remains lethal.
audio: Every good repair part is sitting in water that wants to cook you.
in_game_wiki: Vent Anchor Colonies connect HECTON-8 ecology to crafting routes without turning resources into magic ore.
external_site: Vent Anchor Colonies explain why deep exploration is mechanically necessary. They turn thermal vents into resource engines, biological shelters and pressure hazards, giving the player a reason to move down instead of simply repairing upward.
field_note: Vent anchor: resource sign, temperature hazard, biology shelter and first clue that forge chemistry is alive around the edges.

title: Колонии вент-якорей
scanner: Колониальные ребра цепляются за thermal vents, ловят сульфиды и питают материалы для глубинного ремонта.
terminal: RESOURCE NOTE: vent anchor colonies повышают вероятность sealant и pressure-ceramic. Тепловое воздействие остается смертельным.
audio: Каждая хорошая ремонтная деталь лежит в воде, которая хочет тебя сварить.

audio: Комната слушает мясом и трубой.
in_game_wiki: Акустический орган-фильтр реле задает звуковой слой обслуживания Atlas: организм как перегородка, реле и диагностическое искажение.
external_site: Акустический орган-фильтр реле связывает sonar gameplay HECTON-8 с биомеханическим ужасом Atlas. Поврежденная инфраструктура привлекает живые акустические фильтры, превращая звук в ремонт, ложь и улику.
field_note: Atlas здесь не нужен язык. Ему нужны фильтры, импульсы и живые акустические перегородки.

title: Vent Micronode Nests
scanner: Small warm nodes cluster at vent margins, drawing power and pushing low-grade repair signals into nearby tissue and metal.
terminal: ATLAS POWER TRACE: vent gradient -> micronode heat -> acoustic pulse -> sealant/biofilm response.
audio: It has no grid. It has little fires under the ocean.
in_game_wiki: Vent Micronode Nests explain how Atlas remains active as a distributed maintenance ecology rather than a central villain computer.
external_site: Vent Micronode Nests define the deep Atlas power model. The AI persists through small vent-fed maintenance nodes that push pulses into nearby biology and metal, making the final zone feel like a factory grown from pressure.
field_note: Micronodes explain Atlas persistence without granting clean control: local power, local signal, local maintenance.

title: Гнезда вент-микроузлов

terminal: ATLAS POWER TRACE: vent gradient -> micronode heat -> acoustic pulse -> sealant/biofilm response.
audio: У него нет сети. У него маленькие огни под океаном.

field_note: Micronodes объясняют живучесть Atlas без чистого контроля: локальная энергия, локальный сигнал, локальное обслуживание.

title: Sonar Pinger Route Beacons
scanner: A pinger float marks return geometry, exposes false echoes and can draw both rescue attention and unwanted life.
terminal: PINGER RULE: return line first, sample tag second, distress packet third. Never trust one echo.
audio: One ping is a promise. Two pings are a bill.
in_game_wiki: Sonar Pinger Route Beacons make early equipment stay relevant across exploration, salvage, creature telegraphing and false exits.
external_site: Sonar Pinger Route Beacons are a signature HECTON-8 object: cheap, physical, acoustic and morally loaded. They help the player map, return, tag evidence and negotiate rescue, while also announcing presence to the ocean.
field_note: The pinger is the first honest tool: it tells distance, debt, route loss and creature risk through sound.

title: Маршрутные сонарные пингеры
scanner: Pinger float отмечает геометрию возврата, вскрывает false echoes и может притянуть и помощь, и нежелательную жизнь.
terminal: PINGER RULE: return line first, sample tag second, distress packet third. Never trust one echo.
audio: Один пинг - обещание. Два пинга - счет.
in_game_wiki: Маршрутные сонарные пингеры удерживают раннее снаряжение важным для исследования, salvage, телеграфа существ и ложных выходов.
external_site: Маршрутные сонарные пингеры являются характерным объектом HECTON-8: дешевым, физическим, акустическим и морально нагруженным. Они помогают игроку картировать, возвращаться, метить улики и договариваться о спасении, одновременно объявляя океану о присутствии.
field_note: Pinger - первый честный инструмент: он говорит о дистанции, долге, потере маршрута и риске существ через звук.

title: Lien Severity Seed Class
scanner: The contract has a debt class before it has a destination.
terminal: SEED CLASS: lien severity modifies payout pressure, sample custody and rescue tolerance.
audio: Debt picks the weather before you see the water.
in_game_wiki: Lien Severity Seed Class defines replay as pressure context. The player does not keep power between campaigns; they keep knowledge and choose harder or stranger contract terms.
external_site: Lien Severity Seed Class is the foundation of HECTON-8's replay contract system. It turns debt, blacklist risk and rescue tolerance into authored seed pressure without turning the game into a power-carrying roguelite.
field_note: Lien severity is the seed's pressure valve: it changes terms, not the player's inherited strength.

terminal: AUDIO FAMILY: maximum signal, minimum companionship. Every bark must change pressure, route or evidence read.
audio: If it does not change what the player knows, cut it.

field_note: Families: Black Keel clipped/legal, Deep Reach sanitized/compliance, Marauder practical, Atlas wrong-category maintenance.

title: Salvage Carrier Autonomy Limits
scanner: Carrier autonomy table: claim processing, ballast drop, pings. No deep rescue authority.
terminal: AUTONOMY LIMIT: Black Keel may schedule recovery, reject contaminated mass, sell claim telemetry and drop low-risk supplies. It may not authorize crewed descent or deep-rated rescue without insured receiver approval.
audio: Autonomous does not mean free. It means the debt can move without asking you.
in_game_wiki: Salvage Carrier Autonomy Limits define Black Keel as believable infrastructure. It is competent, useful and dangerous, but not a magic rescue AI.
external_site: The carrier's limits keep HECTON-8 grounded: autonomy covers accounting and recovery, not impossible rescue under ocean pressure.

scanner: Transit lane record. Slow freight survives because infrastructure does the acceleration math.
terminal: ROUTE NOTE: inner domains push probes and freight with beam-sail assists, pellet streams and fusion catch stages. Aegir remains expensive because every missed window turns into years.

title: Acoustic Relay Spine Assembly
scanner: Relay spine partial. The capsule can ping through water, not speak cleanly through orbit.
terminal: ASCENT RELAY: rebuild a low-band acoustic spine before any recovery window. High-gain mast lost. Emergency buoy unreliable. Do not promise rescue without route proof.
audio: If Black Keel hears this, it hears a pressure code, not a voice.
in_game_wiki: The first escape component is not a radio miracle. It is a physical acoustic relay chain: pinger float, ceramic ribs, cable skin and timing discipline.
external_site: HECTON-8 escape is engineering, not a cutscene. The player must rebuild a route for sound before asking orbit to believe the signal.
field_note: Place on broken mast or pinger-line evidence near capsule/P-63 routes.

title: Сборка акустического релейного хребта
scanner: Неполный релейный хребет. Капсула может стучать через воду, но не говорить с орбитой чистым каналом.
terminal: ASCENT RELAY: сначала восстановить низкочастотный акустический хребет. High-gain mast lost. Emergency buoy unreliable. Rescue без route proof запрещен.

field_note: Ставить на сломанную мачту, pinger-line или капсульный/P-63 маршрут.

title: Pressure Seal Clamp Ring Assembly
scanner: Clamp ring scar. The capsule's ascent sleeve is not missing; it was spent during impact survival.
terminal: SEAL CERT: shallow patch holds a room. It does not hold ascent. Certified rings require pressure glass seat, shell-sealant map, and a Deep Reach clamp profile.
audio: The useful seal is the one Atlas grew wrong. That is the problem.
in_game_wiki: Pressure seals explain why the player must go deeper: safe-room repair is not ascent repair, and Atlas bio-sealant can preserve a module while blocking clean separation.
external_site: The damaged capsule cannot simply lift off. Its ascent seal chain needs deep-rated rings, pressure glass and a repair decision that may involve Atlas-grown material.
field_note: Use where repair ecology and mechanical seal evidence overlap.

title: Сборка прижимного кольца герметизации
scanner: След clamp ring. Ascent sleeve не исчез; его потратили, чтобы капсула пережила удар.
terminal: SEAL CERT: shallow patch держит комнату. Он не держит ascent. Нужны pressure glass seat, shell-sealant map и Deep Reach clamp profile.
audio: Полезный уплотнитель здесь тот, который Atlas вырастил неправильно. В этом и проблема.
in_game_wiki: Герметизация объясняет, почему игрок идет глубже: ремонт убежища не равен ремонту взлета, а био-герметик Atlas может спасти модуль и заблокировать отделение.
external_site: Поврежденная капсула не может просто улететь. Ей нужны глубоководные кольца, pressure glass и решение, использовать ли материал, выращенный Atlas.
field_note: Ставить там, где repair ecology пересекается с механикой seal evidence.

title: Ibarra Loss Ledger
scanner: Deep Reach artifact: loss ledger. People, modules and claims share a conversion column.
terminal: IBARRA LEDGER. Personnel load held as continuity loss; claims retain asset rights.
audio: The ledger did not forget names. It made them payable later.
in_game_wiki: The Ibarra ledger is the accounting form of Deep Reach's lie. It treats the colony as unresolved load, preserving rights while delaying truth.
external_site: Deep Reach wants HECTON-8 back because loss conversion never stopped being profitable.
field_note: Use in claim-pool, carrier debt and public liability modules.

title: Журнал потерь Ибарры

audio: Журнал не забыл имена. Он сделал их payable later.
in_game_wiki: Журнал Ибарры - бухгалтерская форма лжи Deep Reach. Он считает колонию нерешенной нагрузкой, сохраняя права и откладывая правду.
external_site: Deep Reach хочет вернуть HECTON-8, потому что конвертация потерь так и не перестала быть выгодной.
field_note: Использовать в claim-pool, carrier debt и публичных liability modules.

title: Sato-Ren Return Packet
scanner: Deep Reach artifact: return-action packet. Coordinates requested before rescue language.
terminal: SATO-REN PACKET. Send coords, Atlas access and sample custody before extraction.
audio: The packet knows where the asset is. It is less certain where you are.
in_game_wiki: The Sato-Ren packet proves Deep Reach is active in 2190. Their present-tense pressure is not a warship; it is compliance language moving through rare signal windows.
external_site: Deep Reach's return to HECTON-8 begins as paperwork: coordinates, custody, access, then maybe rescue.
field_note: Use as bridge between present comms, final payload choices and public spoiler gates.

title: Пакет Сато-Рен
scanner: Артефакт Deep Reach: пакет действия возврата. Координаты требуют раньше языка спасения.
terminal: ПАКЕТ САТО-РЕН. Координаты, доступ Atlas и образец - до эвакуации.
audio: Пакет знает, где актив. Он менее уверен, где ты.
in_game_wiki: Пакет Сато-Рен доказывает, что Deep Reach активна в 2190. Их настоящее давление - не военный корабль, а compliance language в редких окнах сигнала.
